themes.name: Green
themes.description: Arvlad green + navy, lime accent. Values from the Arvlad style guide.

themes.name: Navy
themes.description: Navy + teal, gold accent. Based on Enspire.

themes.name: Yellow / Black
themes.description: Yellow + black, orange accent. Brand yellow is only a CTA fill; links and focus are black.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Short label or status. Soft by default; data-status adds a dot and 14px text for important states (stock, order).
useWhen: Labelling an item (Featured, Draft)
Showing a status that matters (In stock, Sold)
A counter inside a button (Inbox +99)
avoidWhen: Clickable filters: use Chip
More than one accent badge per viewport

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: Soft by default: tone surface with tone text.

examples.title: Solid badges
examples.description: data-style="solid" for strong emphasis, such as New or a counter.

examples.title: Outline badges
examples.description: Transparent with a tone border. Works on coloured surfaces.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: sm (18px), md (22px, default) and lg (28px).

examples.title: Status
examples.description: data-status adds a dot and 14px text for states that matter. Never rely on colour alone.

examples.title: Badge in a button
examples.description: A counter inside a button. The badge shrinks to fit the button size.

components.name: Button
components.description: Triggers an action that changes state: submit, add to cart, enrol. Supports icons (leading, trailing, icon-only square or circle), a loading state and a split layout with a separate icon part. One fill button per section.
useWhen: An action changes state (submit, add to cart, save)
The main action of a section (fill style)
A search row: input and button share data-size
Icon-only (data-shape) for compact repeated actions: favourite, share, close — always with aria-label
Loading (aria-busy) while an action runs after click
Split (data-split) when the icon names the action: download, external link
xl for a hero or a single big CTA, at most one per page
avoidWhen: Plain navigation: use Link
Accent tone on actions: accent is never an action
Disabled as the only signal: explain why in helper text
Icon-only for the main action of a section: give it text
Two different actions in one split button: use two buttons

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: Eight tones. Primary is the default; accent is for highlights, never the main action.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: sm, md (default), lg and xl. Heights follow density: 32 / 40 / 48 / 56px by default.

examples.title: Fill, soft, outline, ghost
examples.description: data-style sets the emphasis. One fill button per section; soft, outline and ghost for the rest.

examples.title: Soft buttons
examples.description: Tone surface with tone text. Good for secondary actions next to a fill button.

examples.title: Outline buttons
examples.description: Page surface with a strong tone border.

examples.title: Ghost buttons
examples.description: No background until hover. For low-emphasis actions such as Cancel.

examples.title: Button with icon
examples.description: Put a Lucide icon before or after the text. The icon inherits the text color.

examples.title: Square and circle button
examples.description: Icon only, width equals height. Always add aria-label.

examples.title: Split button
examples.description: The icon gets its own part, separated by a line (data-split="line") or a darker block (data-split="fill"). Icon before or after.

examples.title: Loading
examples.description: aria-busy="true" with an es-spinner. Keeps the tone colors and blocks clicks while the action runs.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Use disabled only when the reason is visible nearby; otherwise explain it in helper text.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Checkbox or radio with its label. The whole label is clickable (touch target ≥ 44px with padding).
useWhen: Multiple choices (checkbox)
One choice from a short list (radio)
avoidWhen: Instant on/off settings: use Toggle

components.name: Chip
components.description: Toggleable filter or removable selection. State lives in aria-pressed.
useWhen: Quick filters above results
Active filters that can be removed
avoidWhen: Static labels: use Badge or Tag

components.name: Input
components.description: Single-line text field. Use inside Form field for label, helper and error text.
useWhen: Free text, email, number, search
avoidWhen: A fixed list of options: use Select
Long text: use textarea.es-input

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline message with icon, title and text. Info by default; tone sets meaning.
useWhen: Feedback after an action
Important context inside a page or form
avoidWhen: Transient feedback: use Toast
Marketing highlights: use a section with data-surface
components.snippet:
Request sent

We will call you back.

components.name: Listing card
components.description: Card for a product, listing or course: media, status, title (style h4, tag h3), meta, price. The whole card is clickable via the title link.
useWhen: Results in a listing grid (es-grid data-context)
Recommendations
avoidWhen: Full product details: use Product summary

components.name: Dropdown
components.description: A button that shows a menu or any content. Three methods: details/summary (click, native), popover + anchor positioning (top layer), CSS focus (div tabindex). Placement with data-side and data-align.
useWhen: A short list of actions or links behind one button (account menu, sort, more actions)
Compact filters or settings that do not need a full page
avoidWhen: Choosing one value in a form: use Select
More than ~10 items or search inside: use a combobox
Critical content that must stay visible

parts.es-dropdown__content: Content part (ul or div; add popover for method 2)

examples.title: Method 1 · details and summary
examples.description: Native HTML: the summary toggles the content on click. Open or close from JS by adding or removing the open attribute. Closes only when the summary is clicked again.

examples.title: Method 2 · popover and anchor positioning
examples.description: The content opens on the top layer, so there is no z-index or overflow issue. popovertarget points to the content id; anchor-name / position-anchor tie the content to its button. Use a unique id and anchor name per dropdown. Closes on outside click and Esc.

examples.title: Method 3 · CSS focus
examples.description: Opens while the button has focus, closes when focus leaves. The button is a div with tabindex="0" and role="button" because Safari does not focus button elements on click. Do not put elements that take focus away (such as a dialog) inside.

examples.title: Close after click
examples.description: With the focus method, blur the active element when an item is chosen.

examples.title: Menu with icons, label and divider
examples.description: Content can hold a label, icon items, keyboard hints, a divider and a destructive item (data-tone="error").

examples.title: Align: start, center, end
examples.description: data-align aligns the content to the start (default), center or end of the button. Shown forced open with data-open.

examples.title: Side: top and bottom
examples.description: data-side="top" opens above the button, bottom (default) below. Shown forced open with data-open.

examples.title: Side: left and right
examples.description: data-side="left" or "right" opens beside the button, aligned to its top (data-align moves it to center or end).

examples.title: Hover
examples.description: data-hover also opens the dropdown on pointer hover. Keep it clickable too: touch screens have no hover.

examples.title: Any content
examples.description: The content can hold anything, not only a menu. data-padded adds inner padding.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page links for listings. Wrap in nav with aria-label.
useWhen: Listing results over several pages
avoidWhen: Infinite feeds: use a Load more button

components.name: Subscribe form
components.description: Newsletter sign-up: email field and submit button, with optional intro, consent checkbox and result message. Layouts: inline (default), inset (button inside the field), stacked.
useWhen: Newsletter or updates sign-up in a footer, CTA section or sidebar
Any single-field email capture
avoidWhen: Forms with more than one field: use Form field + Button
Login: use a login form

parts.es-subscribe__field: Wraps input + button (the box in inset)
parts.es-subscribe__consent: Optional consent checkbox (with es-checkbox); wrap the text in a span
parts.es-subscribe__message: Result message, data-tone success | error, role=status

examples.title: Inline
examples.description: Default layout: field and button side by side. Below 400px of available width they stack automatically.

examples.title: Inset
examples.description: data-layout="inset": the button sits inside the field box. Radius follows the theme; with radius round it becomes a pill.

examples.title: Inset with consent
examples.description: A required consent checkbox under the field. Link the privacy statement.

examples.title: Stacked with intro
examples.description: data-layout="stacked": full-width rows, for narrow columns, sidebars and footers.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: data-size="lg" makes the field and button 48px (default density).

examples.title: On a coloured surface
examples.description: Inside data-surface="primary" the default button flips to a light fill; the field stays light so it reads as an input.

examples.title: Success and error
examples.description: Show the result under the field in a role="status" message. Mark the field with aria-invalid when the email is wrong.

components.name: CTA
components.description: Single call to action on a coloured surface. One CTA section per page.
useWhen: End of a page or between long content blocks
avoidWhen: Several actions with equal weight

components.name: Hero
components.description: Opening section: overline, display title (h1), lead, two actions, media. Uses section-space-xl.
useWhen: Top of a landing or home page
avoidWhen: Inner pages: use a page header

components.name: Default page
components.description: Page skeleton: sticky header, main of stacked sections, footer.
useWhen: Most content pages
avoidWhen: Listings with filters: use Sidebar left
